name: Determine Highest Normal Form
recognitionClueHinglish: Relation aur FDs diye hain; poocha hai relation kis normal form me hai ya kaunsi form me nahi hai (55 me se 11).
whatShouldComeToMind: Pehle candidate keys, phir har FD ko BCNF, 3NF, 2NF ke liye check.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Prime aur non-prime attributes list karo.
3. Har FD X->A: X superkey hai? to BCNF ok. Nahi to A prime? to 3NF ok.
4. Partial dependency (key ke proper subset -> non-prime) ho to 2NF fail.
5. Sabse upar wali form jo sabhi FDs satisfy kare wahi answer.
variationsObserved: Multiple schemas diye hain, har ek ki form alag alag.
Decomposed relations ki normal form (projection ke FDs se).
commonTraps: Sirf ek key se test karna.

name: Candidate Keys / Superkeys / Counting
recognitionClueHinglish: Kaunsi key hai, kaunsa superkey nahi hai, ya superkeys/keys ki count poochhi hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Jo attributes kisi RHS me nahi aate unhe pakdo.
2. Closure nikaalo; poora R mile to superkey.
3. Minimality check: koi attribute hata ke bhi closure poora rahe to key nahi.
4. Count: single key K ho to 2^(n-|K|) superkeys; multiple keys me inclusion-exclusion.
variationsObserved: Real-world schema (empcode, pincode, street) se FDs khud likhna aur normal form/keys nikaalna.
commonTraps: Superkey ke liye minimality ki zaroorat nahi — candidate key ke liye hai.

name: Attribute Closure, FD Inference, Armstrong, Minimal Cover
recognitionClueHinglish: Poocha hai kaunsi FD implied hai / kaunsi implied nahi hai, ya Armstrong axioms se rule derive karo, ya minimal (irreducible) cover.
whatShouldComeToMind: FD implied hai iff X+ me Y aaye.
Minimal cover me single-attribute RHS, no extra LHS attribute, no redundant FD.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Given FD ke LHS ka closure nikaalo (dusre FDs ke saath).
2. RHS closure me hai to implied.
3. Minimal cover: RHS split, extraneous LHS hatao, redundant FD hatao.
variationsObserved: Relation instance diya hai, kaunsi FD satisfy hoti hai — har FD ke liye tuples ki pair check karo.
'Useful FD' jaisi custom definition (non-empty, non-trivial, etc.).
commonTraps: Instance se FD sabit kar dena.
Trivial FD ki definition (RHS subset of LHS) bhoolna.

name: Decomposition: Lossless Join & Dependency Preservation
recognitionClueHinglish: Relation ko R1,R2 me todha gaya hai; poocha hai lossless hai, dependency-preserving hai, ya dono.
whatShouldComeToMind: Lossless: common attributes kisi ek part ki key hon.
Dependency preserving: har FD kisi ek relation me ya derivable ho.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. R1 intersect R2 nikaalo, uska closure dekho: R1 ya R2 ko determine kare to lossless.
2. Har FD check karo ki kisi decomposed relation me poori aati hai ya closure se recover hoti hai.
3. BCNF/3NF decomposition me pehle violating FD dhundo.
variationsObserved: Decomposition ke baad redundancy compare karna.
'Kaunsi decomposition hamesha lossless dependency-preserving nahi ho sakti'.

name: Conceptual Normal-Form Statements
recognitionClueHinglish: True/false: kaunsa normal form kis se strict hai, 2 attributes wali relation, all-prime attributes, 1NF properties.
whatShouldComeToMind: Do attributes => BCNF. All prime => 3NF. Single-attribute keys => 2NF.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har statement ko chhote counterexample ya definition se test karo.
variationsObserved: BCNF me lossless+dependency-preserving decomposition ki guarantee nahi (3NF me hai).
